tex_content.html:
Definition

A morphism $f\in \operatorname {Hom}_{\mathrm C}(X,Y)$ is an isomorphism if there is $g\in \operatorname {Hom}_{\mathrm C}(Y,X)$ such that \[ f\circ g=\operatorname {Id}_Y, \qquad g\circ f=\operatorname {Id}_X. \]
